heroLine: Bring it in hot. I'll cool it slowly. Don't wait up.
kilnsLede: Nothing has come out of the lehr yet. Each chamber opens when it has cooled enough. Not before.
lehrLines: Don't knock on the door. It knocks back.
It ate a teaspoon once. We don't discuss the teaspoon.
That isn't breathing. That's the draft. Mostly.
You're making it glow. Stop that.
lehrSeventh: Seven. It likes you now. I'd consider that bad news.

lore.text: The workshop is at the end of a street that doesn't appear to have an end. You'll find it anyway. Things that run too hot always do.
I take in what has been overheated. Kettles. Fuses. A clock that struck thirteen out of spite. People leave them on the step and go. Nobody knocks.
There's a lehr in the back. It's a long oven, very old and very patient, and I'd ask you not to stare at its door. It doesn't care for that. Neither do I.
I was brought in once, myself.
The trick isn't the heat. Anyone can make a thing hot. The trick is holding it there, and then letting it go so slowly it never notices it's being let go.
Glass cooled too fast keeps its temper inside. It looks perfectly well. Then one Tuesday, in an empty room, it shatters. Nobody was near it. Nobody ever is.
Nobody else works here. I tried an apprentice once. The lehr didn't take to him, and that was the end of the apprentice.
I don't repair things. I cool them. The difference is mostly patience, and a little of the other thing.
The lehr has never been switched off. Nobody has asked me to.

entries.text: Lit the lehr. It took the match like it had been waiting for one.
Something came in tonight with its teeth showing. I've put it in the first chamber. It's loud in there.
Wrote nothing today. Held the temperature. That counts.
Four objects on the bench now. Two of them are arguing. I'm letting them.

phases.name: Heat
phases.summary: Past the critical point. Everything arrives like this.
phases.note: Don't touch the glass. The glass is touching you.

phases.name: Soak
phases.summary: Held there, long enough for the inside to catch up with the outside.
phases.note: It isn't stuck. It's holding. You'll know the difference later.

phases.name: Slow Cool
phases.summary: The part nobody has patience for. The part that works.
phases.note: Don't open the door to check. Checking is how things crack.

exampleTracks.title: Kettle, Boiled Dry
exampleTracks.object: One enamel kettle, boiled dry. Still screaming at intake.
exampleTracks.note: Took the whistle out. It kept whistling. We've agreed to disagree.

exampleTracks.title: Fusebox
exampleTracks.object: One fuse box. Three fuses blown, one of them proud of it.
exampleTracks.note: Customer says it just went. Things don't just go.

intake.title: Bring something in
intake.prompt: What made you hot today? Write it down and leave it in the lehr. Nobody reads these but the lehr.
intake.empty: Nothing on the bench. Lucky you. Or you're lying.
replies: Cooled. It looks smaller from here. Most things do.
Held it overnight. It stopped shaking around four.
It's not gone. It's annealed. You can hold it now without it holding you.
There was less in it than you thought. There usually is.
I've seen worse come in. I've seen worse go out, too.
It cooled without cracking. That was the whole job.
Set it on the shelf. You don't have to look at it, but you can.

counter.title: Leave your name at the counter
counter.intro: Nothing has come out of the lehr yet. Leave your name and I'll write when the first chamber opens. Once per chamber, and not otherwise.
replies: Noted. I'll write when something comes out of the lehr. Don't wait up.
Your name's in the ledger. In ink. That was your decision.
Heard the bell. Didn't come out. I'll write.
Good. Somebody should know when it's done.
The lehr made a noise when you signed. I'm choosing to take that as approval.
counter.returning: You again, {name}. Your name's still on the ledger.
counter.selfName: That's my name. Put it back.
counter.badEmail: That address won't take a letter. Check it and ring again.
counter.noName: The ledger needs a name. Any name. Most people lie.
counter.failed: The bell didn't ring. Try again in a moment.

footer: Cooled at 1 °C per minute. Do not rush the glass.
credits: All work done on the premises. Nobody else works here.
